meaning:
Ζαβουλών, ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְבוּלוּן see Gen.30:20)
Zebulun, Jacob's tenth son: the tribe of Z., Mat.4:13, 15, Rev.7:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
